```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Load Dataset

```{r}
data <- read_csv("../data/Student_Mental_Stress_and_Coping_Mechanisms.csv")

# Clean column names for ease of use
colnames(data) <- make.names(colnames(data))
```

# Feature Engineering

## 1. Weekly Aggregates

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    weekly_social_media_hours = Social.Media.Usage..Hours.per.day. * 7,
    weekly_sleep_hours = Sleep.Duration..Hours.per.night. * 7,
    weekly_exercise_hours = Physical.Exercise..Hours.per.week.
  )
```

## 2. Academic Load Index (Raw and Normalised)

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    academic_load_index = Academic.Performance..GPA. * Study.Hours.Per.Week,
    academic_load_index_scaled = rescale(academic_load_index, to = c(0, 1))
  )
```

## 3. Stress Category (Based on Mental Stress Level)

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    stress_category = case_when(
      Mental.Stress.Level <= 3 ~ "Low",
      Mental.Stress.Level <= 6 ~ "Moderate",
      Mental.Stress.Level >= 7 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

## 4. Healthy Lifestyle Score

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    healthy_score = as.integer(Sleep.Duration..Hours.per.night. >= 7) +
                    as.integer(Physical.Exercise..Hours.per.week. >= 3) +
                    as.integer(Diet.Quality >= 3)
  )
```

## 5. Categorical Coping Type

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(coping_type = case_when(
    str_detect(Stress.Coping.Mechanisms, regex("meditation|breathing|yoga|alone", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Emotional",
    str_detect(Stress.Coping.Mechanisms, regex("talking|family|friends", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Social",
    str_detect(Stress.Coping.Mechanisms, regex("reading|drawing|writing", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Creative",
    str_detect(Stress.Coping.Mechanisms, regex("music|watching sports", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Relaxation",
    str_detect(Stress.Coping.Mechanisms, regex("travelling|nature", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Adventure",
    str_detect(Stress.Coping.Mechanisms, regex("social media", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Distraction",
    str_detect(Stress.Coping.Mechanisms, regex("exercise", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Physical",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))
```

## 6. At-Risk Flag

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    at_risk = ifelse(
      Mental.Stress.Level >= 7 &
      Sleep.Duration..Hours.per.night. <= 5 &
      Diet.Quality <= 2, 1, 0)
  )
```

## Feature Preview

```{r}
glimpse(data)
summary(data)
```
